        }
    }
}

# 2026-11-15：老存档迁移。旧版本把没有方案的次级槽自动填成「选项列表第一项」（贸易），
# 于是一产星球的三个次级槽图标都显示贸易。这里把「三个槽都是贸易」的普通星球重置为
# 新的默认三族（能量/矿物/农业）；特殊星球（环世界/城市世界等）保持原样。
carrier_event = {
    id = colony_automation_event.29
    hide_window = yes
    is_triggered_only = yes
    trigger = {
        always = yes
    }
    immediate = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { bca_has_advance_secondary_districts = yes }
                has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_z3_trade
                has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_z4_trade
                has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_z5_trade
            }
            bca_planet_setting_clear_zone_selection = {
                ZONE_SLOT = z3
            }
            bca_planet_setting_clear_zone_selection = {
                ZONE_SLOT = z4
            }
            bca_planet_setting_clear_zone_selection = {
                ZONE_SLOT = z5
            }
            bca_secondary_slot_default_first = {
                ZONE_SLOT = z3
            }
            bca_secondary_slot_default_second = {
                ZONE_SLOT = z4
            }
            bca_secondary_slot_default_third = {
                ZONE_SLOT = z5
            }
        }
    }
}
